indexes.name: ca_hand_player_idx_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ca_hand_player_idx_pkey ON public.ca_hand_player_idx USING btree (user_id, hand_id)

indexes.name: idx_ca_hand_player_idx_hand_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ca_hand_player_idx_hand_id ON public.ca_hand_player_idx USING btree (hand_id)

indexes.name: idx_ca_hand_player_idx_user_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ca_hand_player_idx_user_time ON public.ca_hand_player_idx USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)

triggers.name: ca_hand_player_idx_takes_its_hands_asset
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER ca_hand_player_idx_takes_its_hands_asset BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF asset, hand_id ON public.ca_hand_player_idx FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_hand_player_row_takes_its_hands_asset()
